brand.title: SEO / GEO report
brand.sub: Samsung ultrasound · Swiss Google and AI assistants · September 2026 to January 2027

goal: Be the answer for “Samsung ultrasound” in Swiss Google and in AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews) in German, French, Italian and English.
method: Every month the same 20 Swiss Google searches and 20 AI prompts are measured the same way: three live Swiss Google queries per term via DataForSEO, best position kept; each prompt sent once to ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity with web search on. Numbers are comparable from October 2026 onwards. September is the pre-programme baseline from Semrush and manual checks, shown for context only.

kpis.label: Tracked searches on page 1
kpis.help: How many of the 20 tracked Swiss Google searches show meditron.ch in the top 10 results (page 1). Each term is queried three times; the best position counts.

kpis.label: Tracked searches in top 20
kpis.help: How many of the 20 tracked searches show meditron.ch anywhere in the top 20 results (pages 1 and 2). Same three-query method.

kpis.label: Average position where ranking
kpis.help: The average ranking position across the tracked searches where meditron.ch appears at all. Position 1 is the top result, so lower is better.

kpis.label: AI Overviews citing Meditron
kpis.note: Google's AI answer, when it appears
kpis.help: Of the tracked searches where Google shows its AI Overview answer, how many list meditron.ch as one of the sources. Shown as cited / shown.

kpis.label: AI answers naming Meditron
kpis.help: Each of the 20 prompts is sent to ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity (60 answers). This counts the answers that mention Meditron by name.

kpis.label: AI answers citing meditron.ch
kpis.help: Of the same 60 AI answers, how many list meditron.ch among the sources they link to.

kpis.label: Prompts where Meditron is named first
kpis.help: Of the 20 prompts, how many where Meditron is the first company named in the answer, ahead of any competitor, across the three engines.

kpis.label: Insights articles live
kpis.help: Insights articles published on meditron.ch, each counted once, with English, German, French and Italian versions.

kpis.label: Google clicks, month
kpis.help: Visits from Google search to meditron.ch in the month, from Google Search Console. Needs Meditron to grant access.

kpis.label: Google impressions, month
kpis.help: How often meditron.ch appeared in Google results in the month, from Google Search Console. Needs Meditron to grant access.

months.label: September 2026

months.source: Semrush Domain Overview (CH) 29 Sep; manual ChatGPT and Gemini checks 29 Sep. Not the same method as later months.

done.text: Programme plan agreed. German confirmed as master language; English stays the default locale.
Technical audit of the new Framer site: broken German title, no H1s, no structured data, /old-home indexed.
Live: 53 redirects from old URLs, sitemap with 238 pages per language, Search Console verified, hub page intro and FAQ in EN and DE.
H1 headings site-wide. Structured data (Organization, two LocalBusiness, Product, Breadcrumb, Article). Titles and descriptions in four languages. Alt text on 219 product images.
Semrush baseline taken. Six articles drafted in English and German. Article template: contents list, FAQ accordion, author byline.

Articles 1–3 published. “Latest” renamed to “Insights” in the navigation and footer. Home section renamed “News and Insights”. Article images standardised at 3:2 with the Meditron mark on brand colours.

log.text: Kick-off, strategy, keyword cluster, redirect map.
Redirects, indexing, four locales, hub content live on 16 Sep.
H1s, structured data, site hygiene, three English article drafts.
Baseline measured, six articles in EN and DE, three published, Insights category, image system.

months.label: October 2026
months.status: Third reading, 20 October. Page 1 for 9 of 20 tracked Swiss searches (average position 11.2, down from 8.9 a week ago, mostly English terms slipping), named in 18 of 60 AI answers with 20 citations. SMD Medical now holds a top-3 result on 7 of the 20 searches and is named next to Meditron in every 'who sells' answer. Six articles live; the HERA Z20 page with its seven probe pages is on staging.

examples: best ultrasound machine for a gynaecology practice

ecografo per studio medico, quale scegliere

tiers.name: Tier 2 · brand, no country
tiers.result: Model and price prompts: Meditron named in 1 of 24 answers, site cited in 5. No pricing will be published, so the price prompts stay informational; the model pages are where this tier moves once the Z20, V8, R20 and V7 pages are live.

tiers.name: Tier 3 · brand + Switzerland (core targets)
tiers.result: Core prompts: Meditron named in 12 of 12 answers, site cited in 8, named first in all four languages on all three engines. SMD Medical is named alongside in every answer.

tiers.name: Tier 4 · “official distributor” wording
tiers.result: No prompt in the tracking list uses the 'official distributor' wording. The core answers already call Meditron the official distributor; four prompts can be added next week.

tiers.name: Tier 5 · service, used, leasing
tiers.result: New-or-used prompts: Meditron named in 1 of 12 answers (Italian, ChatGPT). A pre-owned page would address this directly.

tiers.name: Tier 6 · Meditron named

done.text: German and French article URLs now carry German and French slugs (e.g. /de/news-events/ultraschallgeraet-neu-oder-occasion). Old URLs redirect. Publish dates staggered across September.
Articles 4 to 6 on staging in EN, DE and FR with images and FAQ. Tracking list of 24 Google terms and 20 AI prompts agreed. Article tables fixed for narrow screens.
DataForSEO connected. First direct measurement of the 24 tracked Swiss searches and 20 AI prompts across ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Tables added to this report.
Article 4 (HERA Z20 or V8 for gynaecology) live in EN, DE and FR. Publishing cadence agreed: three articles a week, Mon/Wed/Fri; articles 5 and 6 follow on 7 and 9 Oct.
Italian versions of all six articles added: titles, intros, bodies, FAQ and Italian URLs, with redirects from the old Italian URLs.
Articles 5 (mobile or stationary) and 6 (first 90 days) published in EN, DE, FR and IT. Six articles live.

Second measurement of the 20 Google terms and 20 AI prompts. Average position improved from 11.8 to 8.9; HERA Z20 moved from 13–16 to 10 in EN and DE; 'ecografo samsung' reached position 1. AI citations rose from 15 to 21 of 60.
Third measurement. English model terms slipped (HERA Z20 10 to 24), Italian and German improved; AI answers naming Meditron 18 of 60, citations 20. SMD Medical now in the top 3 on 7 of 20 searches.

Articles 7 (service, training and warranty), 8 (leasing) and 9 (buying checklist for a GP practice) on staging in EN, DE, FR and IT with FAQ rows, dated 27, 29 and 31 October. German language audit delivered as a Google Doc for Jean; indexing audit with seven ranked findings written.

log.text: German and French article URLs, articles 4 to 6 staged, tracking list, tool decision (Search Console + DataForSEO).
Articles 5 and 6 live. HERA Z20 model page rewritten with seven transducers (staging). Second measurement run.

Product CMS audit: probes become compatible products with their own pages, related models get a field of their own. Hub page heading spacing. Dashboard gains the product-page summary and a checkable To-discuss list. Third measurement on 20 Oct.
Indexing check: robots, sitemaps, canonicals, hreflang, site: count (about 775 indexed of 980 sitemap URLs). Three findings need Meditron or Framer; none need a content change.

next: Deploy the HERA Z20 and probe pages to production after Meditron's look at staging.
Model page copy for V8, R20 and V7 from the briefs, same structure as the Z20.
Weekly rerun of the 20 Google terms and 20 AI prompts every Monday.
Decide on the pre-owned page; claim the two Google Business Profiles.
Add Search Console clicks and impressions once access is granted.

discuss.why: The old site is still online and indexed. Who controls its hosting and DNS, so it can redirect to www.meditron.ch?
Hub and model pages now lead with 'Samsung Ultraschall'. Home and About still use brand lines. Should the home headline say what Meditron is?
The 'Our why' text animates letter by letter, which scrambles it for translation tools, screen readers and AI. Keep it, or switch to plain text?
'Ultraschallgerät Occasion' is a strong buying search. A live pre-owned list would rank for it. Is there stock, and who keeps it current?

discuss.topic: Samsung's partner listing and SMD Medical
discuss.why: Samsung Healthcare's site has a 'Global Network' map, not a crawlable partner list, so a link from it is unlikely. SMD Medical is now also a Samsung partner in Switzerland. What is Meditron's agreement with Samsung, and can 'official distributor since 2012' be backed by a Samsung statement?
Rolle and Frauenfeld profiles feed map results and AI answers. Who owns the Google account?

Seven older news items have English URLs and English text in DE, FR and IT, so Google sees duplicate pages. Translate the three Samsung-related ones (1'000 systems, 35 years, Esaote) with German and French URLs and archive the rest?
The Events tab is hidden. Congress pages earn links and local searches. Any 2026 or 2027 dates to list?
Articles use brand-colour placeholders. Real product or practice photos would lift click-through. Is there a photo library?
The home page is 1.4 MB with 194 images, heavy for phones and crawlers. Worth trimming sections?

working: The core question still goes Meditron's way: 'who sells Samsung ultrasound in Switzerland' names Meditron first in all four languages on all three engines (12 of 12), and meditron.ch is cited in 20 of 60 answers.
Italian is the strongest market: position 1 for 'ecografo samsung', 'ecografo samsung prezzo' and 'ecografo usato svizzera', position 5 for the generic practice term.
German brand term back on page 1 (9, from 15); 'samsung v8 ultraschall' at 5; French 'échographe occasion suisse' at 3 with a Google AI Overview citing meditron.ch.
Foundations complete: redirects, four languages, structured data, H1s, six Insights articles, product CMS model fixed (probes as compatible products).
gaps: English slipped: 'samsung ultrasound' 7 to 12, 'samsung hera z20' 10 to 24, 'ultrasound machine switzerland' and 'samsung ultrasound price' out of the top 50. English is the default locale, so this is the page Google trusts least; the Z20, V8, R20 and V7 rewrites and the seven probe pages are still only on staging, so Google keeps indexing the old pages.
Model prompts: no engine names Meditron for 'HERA Z20 or V8' in English (Lysis is named first); the German version names Meditron on ChatGPT only. The model pages are the fix and they are not live.

Indexing (25 Oct check): the English sitemap lists the six German article URLs without /de/, all 404; legacy.meditron.ch is still live and indexed next to the new site; seven old news posts sit under English URLs in DE, FR and IT. Full list and fixes in the indexing audit.
Generic 'which ultrasound for a practice in Switzerland' prompts now go to MHZ in DE, FR and IT (named first on 3 of 4). Meditron is named only in EN and FR on two engines.
German buying searches still invisible: 'ultraschallgerät kaufen' (140 a month) and 'ultraschallgerät occasion' are held by shops and marketplaces; the pre-owned page decision is still open.
No click or impression data: Search Console access is still outstanding, so none of this can be tied to visits.
opportunities: Publish the HERA Z20 page and probe pages to production, then V8, R20 and V7 the same way: model searches and model prompts are where a dealer can beat Samsung's own site and SMD Medical.

Three more Insights articles are on staging (service and training, leasing, buying checklist) and go live with the next production publish; nine articles in four languages then cover every question in the tracked prompt list.
A pre-owned stock page would own the 'Occasion' searches and the Italian and French used-machine answers that already cite meditron.ch.
'Which ultrasound for a Swiss practice' is an open question in DE and IT: one guide per language, built on article 1, would take the MHZ answers.
Two Google Business Profiles (Rolle, Frauenfeld) and a Samsung Healthcare partner mention are the cheapest authority gains and feed the AI answers directly.
risks: SMD Medical is now in the top 3 for 7 of 20 tracked searches (was 4) and is named alongside Meditron in all 12 'who sells' answers. With the FMH Services 15% discount it is the name a price-sensitive practice hears first.
English rankings are volatile week to week; one weak reading is not a trend, but three model-page terms moving the same way is.
Search volume for the category is small; rankings alone will not fill the pipeline. Demos, referrals and congresses still do most of the work.
Articles go live on a fixed schedule without a Meditron read-through; a factual slip on a medical page costs more than a late article.

focus: Merge the two open Framer branches and publish production: HERA Z20, V8, R20, V7 copy, the seven probe pages and articles 7 to 9 are all waiting on that one click.
Redirect legacy.meditron.ch to www.meditron.ch (hosting/DNS, Meditron) so the old site stops competing on brand searches.
Report the sitemap bug to Framer: six German article URLs appear in the English sitemap and 404.
Decide the pre-owned stock page and the legacy news posts (translate, archive or hide).
Jean reviews the German audit in the Google Doc; approved wording goes live through the API, nothing is changed before that.
Grant Search Console access: it is the only source that shows which of the ~200 missing URLs are not indexed and why.
Hold the 20 tracked terms and prompts unchanged; add the 10 'watch list' prompts as a separate block from next week.

productModel.title: Product pages: how the three link types work
productModel.sub: Every product page can show three kinds of linked items under the body copy. The audit on 20 October found the HERA Z20 test page had two of them the wrong way round; the fix below is on staging.

types.name: Variants
types.what: Versions of the same product you can order. Small cards with a picture, a name and one line; no page of their own, not clickable.

examples.label: Lead Glasses: Discovery, Focus, Nike Blue, Nike Silver
Radioprotective Aprons: Coat, Vest & Kilt, Front
Head and Neck Solutions: five immobilisation systems
Piranha: Premium, Dental, Mammo, CT, R/F, Multi

types.name: Compatible Products
types.what: Add-ons that work with this product: probes for an ultrasound system. Each card opens the add-on's own product page.
types.used: Not used before this fix. The field label in the CMS also carried a typo ("Compactible"), now corrected.

examples.label: Samsung CA1-7Sv2 probe page listing the Z20 (staging)

types.name: Related Products
types.what: Other models a buyer should also look at. New field added on 20 October, shown as "Related models".
types.used: HERA Z20 only so far: V8, R20, V6.

examples.label: HERA Z20: V8, R20, V6 under Related models (staging)

productModel.wrong: On the HERA Z20 test page (8 October) the probes were filed under Variants and the V8, R20 and V6 under Compatible Products. Nothing reached production.
ultrasound: Every Samsung system page will follow one pattern: body copy, technical data, Compatible Products = its probes, Related Products = neighbouring models. Variants stays empty and the section hides itself.
Probes become products with their own pages, for example /products/samsung-ca1-7sv2. Several probes fit more than one system, so one probe page can sit under the V8 and the Z20 at the same time.
Order of work: HERA Z20 first (seven probes, done on staging), then V8, R20, V7, then V6, V5, V4. Each model only adds the probes not already created.

Probe pages are hidden from the catalogue grid for now so the Ultrasound listing keeps showing systems; they are reachable from the system pages and indexable. One flag turns them on in the catalogue.
Needed from Meditron: real probe photos (placeholder tiles are in use) and a check of the Swiss probe set per system. Specs stay limited to what Samsung publishes.
German stays with the Meditron team. New probe pages show English under /de/ until translated. Clarius and Esaote pages are untouched.
